questions.q: What is this video about?
questions.e: In the video: "u današnjem videu ću vam pokazati everyday makeup".

questions.q: Which product does the author apply first?
questions.e: In the video: "Prva stvar koju stavljam na svoje lice jeste ovaj Catrice Sensitive Moisturizing Serum Milk".

questions.q: What does the Nivea BB cream do?
questions.e: In the video: "ona daje neku blagu boju".

questions.q: Where does the author apply concealer?
o: Under the eyes and on freckles
questions.e: In the video: "ispod očiju gde imam podočnjake... gde imam pegice".

questions.q: Why does she add a little powder after the concealer?
o: So that nothing smears when applying bronzer, highlighter and blush
questions.e: In the video: "preko ovog korektora da mi ne bi se sve razmazivalo posle kad budem stavljala bronzere, hajlajtere, rumenila".

questions.q: What is the Astra highlighter suitable for?
questions.e: In the video: "Znači on se može koristiti i za lice i za telo".

questions.q: Why does she use the empty Givenchy mascara?
o: Because of the very good brush
The mascara is no longer sold
questions.e: In the video: "ova maskara je prazna. Ali ja koristim zbog ove četkice jer je mnogo dobra".

questions.q: What does she finally do with the lipstick?
o: Applies red over the light and dark ones
questions.e: In the video: "Zapravo ovog puta ću malo promeniti. I staviću crven preko ovoga... Ispalo je prelepo".

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Sada ga samo rukama *razmažem* svuda.
questions.e: Razmazati — to smear, to blend.

questions.q: Ispod očiju gde imam *podočnjake*.
questions.e: Podočnjak — dark circles under the eyes; pod + oči.

questions.q: Na mesta gde imam *pegice*.
questions.e: Pegica — a freckle.

questions.q: Za njega koristim veliku *četkicu*.
questions.e: Četkica — a small brush.

questions.q: Sledeća stvar je *rumenilo*.
questions.e: Rumenilo — blush; rumen — rosy.

questions.q: Bukvalno sve su *šljokičaste*.
questions.e: Šljokičast — with glitter.

questions.q: Staviću *senku* na oči.
questions.e: Senka — shadow; on the eyes it means eyeshadow.

questions.q: Poslednja stvar je *ruž* za usne.
questions.e: Ruž — lipstick.

questions.q: Prva stvar koju stavljam na svoje ___ jeste serum.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where to?" — accusative case; for neuter nouns it coincides with the nominative: lice.

questions.q: Stavim ga ispod ___ gde imam podočnjake.
questions.e: Ispod ("under") requires the genitive case: ispod očiju.

questions.q: Na neka mesta gde imam ___.
questions.e: Imati + object — accusative plural: pegice.

questions.q: Malo ga stavim na ___, na čelo.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where to?" — accusative case: na nos.

questions.q: Rumenilo stavljam sa ovom ___.
questions.e: Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: sa četkicom.

questions.q: Na ___ oka malo da produžim senku.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where to?" — accusative case: na ugao.

questions.q: Hvala vam što ste ___ ovaj video.
questions.e: What you watched — past tense, plural: ste gledali.

questions.q: Dole u ___ mi pišite šta još želite.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative plural: u komentarima.
